title: Signed by Microsoft and Mozilla: a Brazilian kit that hands your logged-in browser to an operator
description: HardwareInfo.msi is a malicious Windows installer targeting Brazilian users that silently installs a browser hijacking toolkit. It uses a private Python runtime and a renamed legitimate Windows program to load a fake system DLL signed by a Dutch company. The core malicious logic is in a signed compiled Python module that forcibly closes browsers, installs malicious extensions in Chrome, Edge, and Firefox, and steals saved passwords and cookies. Additionally, it sets up a hidden Chrome instance that an attacker can remotely control while the user is logged in.
